name: typequest
description: TypeScript を学ぶための学習アプリ。ソースコード自体が実践的な TypeScript の教材です。

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.mjs && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @typequest/api" "npm run dev -w @typequest/web"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @typequest/api
scripts.deploy:init: npm run build && npm run deploy:init -w @typequest/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.e2e:serve: npm run build && npm run e2e:serve -w @typequest/api
